payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort the array ascending, then swap first and last elements to place max at front and min at end, maximizing x1-xn.
payload.rationale: The solution relies on sorting to arrange elements, then a simple exchange to achieve the specific lexicographically smallest optimal permutation. The approach is equivalent to a custom sort order but implemented via standard sort and swap. Other subtypes (sweep line, binary search) are inapplicable.
